verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a live llms.txt at docs.adyen.com that explicitly covers point-of-sale documentation. A second probe confirmed agent-friendly Markdown versions of the in-person payments docs (point-of-sale.md) return HTTP 200, and many cited doc URLs are .md endpoints. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/Markdown agent-docs offering and its completeness (e.g., a full-content llms-full.txt variant).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
